evidence: Modifies src/index/txindex.cpp to throw runtime errors on I/O failure and corruption instead of returning empty results.
rationale: TxIndex previously returned false on disk read errors or corruption, silently reporting existing transactions as missing. Commit fa5c96a112 notes that 'a -txindex corruption may also point to a larger system corruption and it seems better to notify the user properly by throwing an exception,' protecting callers from treating index failures as non-existent data.
